messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The Crestor brand of rosuvastatin tablets is distributed by AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals LP.
AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals LP is located in Wilmington, DE 19850.
The distribution is under license from Shionogi & Co., LTD.
Shionogi & Co., LTD. is located in Osaka, Japan.
Generic versions are also manufactured by several other companies.
Ezallor Sprinkle (rosuvastatin) has been discontinued and is no longer available.
Triplet: ["rosuvastatin", "has generic versions manufactured by", "other companies"]

The relation 'has generic versions manufactured by' in the triplet is defined as 'The generic version of the subject drug is manufactured by the companies specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
C. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
D. 'has multiple brands and forms': The subject drug is available in multiple brands and forms as specified by the object entity.
E. 'manufacturer parent company': The subject drug's manufacturer is a subsidiary or division of the parent company specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
